note: Generated by design/tools/palettes.py. linear = linear-light sRGB 0..1, multiply by an HDR intensity from design/look.md. Enemy hues per run: see selectionRule; their gradient partners: see partnerRule. players[i].deep and .light are that player's second and third colours.

selectionRule.text: Take enemyCandidates in listed order; skip any whose hue is within minHueGapDanger of the danger hue or within minHueGapPlayer of a present player's hue (colours with chroma below lowChroma are exempt from those two), or within minHueGapGold of the gifts' golds (P4's hue and the pickup's, in every run, whatever the chroma: 2026-11-15); use the first three that remain; if fewer than three remain, fill with the skipped candidates that violate the gaps least.

partnerRule.text: Every enemy hue has three candidate partners (enemyCandidates[i].partners): its hue moved hueStep degrees up or down the wheel, and the hue itself, lighter. Use whichever of the first two keeps clear of the danger hue, every present player's hue and the golds by the larger margin (on a tie the first); if neither keeps clear, the third. soloPartner and fourPlayerPartner are that choice precomputed for P1 alone and for all four players.
